messages:
anya: quick alert 15m before cutover for release/3.9.0: deploy-bot blocked final push due to SBOM license + a medium vuln on a transitive lib. need fast triage: exception, pin, or rollback.

paul: paste deploy-bot output pls.

deploy-bot: compliance: sbom-license-check/4683329900 FAILED
- package: third_party/async-png@0.9.1
- license: AGPL-3.0-only (policy: block unless vendor-approved)
vuln-scan-staging/4683329901: 1 medium (libjpeg-turbo 2.1.0) - CVE-2022-4242 - score 5.0 - exploitability low
artifact: gcr.io/redwood/release/3.9.0-canary@sha256:cafe1234

kevin: AGPL is problematic. is async-png used on the default code path?

anya: it's only used by an opt-in image-optim pipeline for customers who enable advanced compression. default pipeline unaffected.

paul: legal-oncall? can we get a short-lived exception?

security-bot: exception template: require signed SBOM link, mitigation note, SEC ticket, rollback owner, and monitoring window.

anya: I've drafted mitigation: "Async-png (AGPL-3.0-only) used only in opt-in image-optim path. Feature disabled by default for canary. Patch plan: replace library in 3.9.1 within 10 days. Runtime IDS in place."

paul: SBOM attestation present: s3://redwood-artifacts/attestations/3.9.0-canary/cosign.sig (sha256:dd44aa55bb66cc77)

kevin: I'll own rollback if anything goes wrong (revert to 3.8.7).

paul: legal has verbally okayed a scoped canary exception for US-east only, pending SEC ticket.

anya: created SEC-6100: https://triage.internal/sec/6100 with remediation ETA and mitigation note.

deploy-bot: action: canary rollout -> US-east (25% traffic), start_ts 4683333600.

anya: decision: proceed with scoped canary under exception. global rollout blocked until remediation. if alerts or IDS fires, kevin will trigger rollback. will update release notes.

kevin: setting PagerDuty watch and alert thresholds.

paul: thanks everyone, closing this thread unless rollback occurs.
